label: QuickJS (Wasm)
notes: An instance is its own Wasm module instance with its own linear memory, instantiated from one WebAssembly.Module compiled once (1.83 ms), plus a runtime with a 64 MiB memory limit and a context.
Memory: resident growth of the Node host across 100 live instances, after two forced GCs before and after.
Start: median of 40 creates after 3 warm-ups: instantiate the module, create the runtime and context, evaluate 1 + 1.

Tool call: cpu_bench.mjs. The guest awaits an async host function that resolves its promise before returning it. Median of per-batch means, 20,000 calls in batches of 100 after 2,000 warm-ups; 40.78 µs of CPU per call, mostly quickjs-emscripten's handle API.
When the host answers on a later event-loop turn (inproc.mjs) a call costs 34.6 µs per call, timed from one host call to the next.
Compute: one instance runs the task, interpreted (QuickJS has no JIT), with no memory limit or interrupt handler set.
